name: jongminchung

scripts.build: pnpm run icon:check && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.check: pnpm run fmt:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run workspace:graph:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.check:full: pnpm run check && pnpm run typecheck:e2e && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.check:full:electron: pnpm run check:full && pnpm --filter @jongminchung/git-client run test:electron
scripts.check:full:materials: pnpm run check:full && pnpm --filter @jongminchung/engineering-docs run test:e2e:materials
scripts.deps:update: npm-check-updates -u --workspaces --target latest --packageManager pnpm --reject typescript && pnpm install
scripts.publish:dry-run: pnpm --filter @jongminchung/remark-plantuml run publish:dry-run && pnpm --filter @jongminchung/tooling run publish:dry-run && pnpm --filter @jongminchung/ui run publish:dry-run
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @jongminchung/engineering-docs run test:e2e:core && pnpm --filter @jongminchung/readme run test:e2e:core && pnpm --filter @jongminchung/git-client run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:visual: pnpm --filter @jongminchung/engineering-docs run test:e2e:visual && pnpm --filter @jongminchung/readme run test:e2e:visual
scripts.typecheck:e2e: pnpm --filter @jongminchung/engineering-docs run typecheck:e2e && pnpm --filter @jongminchung/readme run typecheck:e2e

//: audit:prod checks production dependency advisories at high severity or above.
It stays separate from check because the advisory database requires network access; CI runs it on a scheduled security lane.
